newsitem.title: HONG KONG: PRESS DIGEST - HK newspaper headlines - Dec 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - HK newspaper headlines - Dec 13.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Hong Kong press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- SOUTH CHINA MORNING POST -- Chief Executive-designate Tung Chee-hwa made it clear Anson Chan is his choice for the first chief secretary of the Special Administrative Region.
-- The Hong Kong Monetary Authority is seeking ways to alleviate pressure on the banking system caused by huge oversubscriptions of new issues.
-- HONG KONG ECONOMIC JOURNAL -- The Preparatory Committee finalised a list of 130 candidates for the provisional legislature that will replace the Legislative Council after the handover.

-- HONG KONG STANDARD -- A technical defect caused chaos at the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong when the bourse's computer erroneously showed the Hang Seng Index had plunged more than 500 points at the opening of trade.

-- MING PAO -- After four reports of contaminated produce, health officials discovered one sample of vegetables from China containing pesticides above permitted levels. The 500 kg shipment was destroyed.

-- APPLE DAILY -- Hong Kong Monetary Authority chief executive Joseph Yam said the authority would not consider requesting banks to further lower mortgage rates, adding that it was up to individual banks to set their mortgage policies.
